figures.name: heat-rescaling
figures.label: qenormal-fig-heat
alts: Heat densities at times 1/4, 1, and 4: equal total mass, with wider, shorter curves at later times.
After dividing position by the square root of time and rescaling the density, all three heat profiles coincide with the standard normal curve.
